name: La Granja: Deluxe Master Set

categories.label: Victory points on the score track
categories.hint: VP earned during play (deliveries, crafts, market, siesta track, roofs). Take the VP total before converting silver.

categories.label: Silver after selling remaining goods
categories.labelVi: Bạc sau khi bán hết hàng còn lại
categories.hint: Sell goods in dens/stalls at sale price and trade commodities at 4 silver (not goods in fields, not upgraded goods), add coins held. 5 silver = 1 VP.

categories.label: Colchonera markers (module)
categories.hint: 1/2/3 markers = 1/3/6 VP, then +3 VP per extra marker.

categories.label: Long Distance Trade goods (module)
categories.hint: Discard 1 farm good per marker you placed of that type for the VP shown on the sideboard (done before converting silver).

tiebreakers.description: Most silver remaining among tied players.

notes: family: sum-of-categories (VP track + silver conversion). Silver tiebreaker: enter raw silver; remainder after 5:1 exchange is the 'silver remaining'. Solo mode not modelled. Other modules (dice, helpers) do not change final scoring per module book.
